integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible exact finite cyclotomic tests; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The prime must be odd and the level invertible modulo its square.
No claim for higher ring length, even primes, or nonunit shells.
An equivalent special case of broader Salié/Bessel literature may exist.
title: Square-class Fourier support of unit quadratic shells over prime-square rings
